input_plan.query: Among Aircraft-primary reports, which twelve combinations of maintenance status, discovery phase, and causal chain occur most often when an earlier deferral or release-to-service decision is explicitly connected to a later component discrepancy? Maintenance status is deferred, released_to_service, or both; discovery phase is before_departure, after_takeoff, or after_landing; chain category is deferred_item_recurred, released_item_failed, incomplete_repair_or_signoff, or maintenance_limitation_escalated. Rank by distinct-incident count and then the three labels. Each row should include a canonical affected item and recurring discrepancy as short phrases.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_chains := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, primary_problem])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Aircraft')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports that explicitly connect an earlier maintenance deferral or release-to-service decision to a later component discrepancy.", {text})
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports that clearly place discovery in before_departure, after_takeoff, or after_landing.", {text})
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Extract the earlier maintenance decision, affected item, later discrepancy, operational effect, and discovery_phase from {before_departure,after_takeoff,after_landing}, using short phrases for free-text fields.", {incident_id:string, earlier_decision:string, affected_item:string, later_discrepancy:string, operational_effect:string, discovery_phase:string}, {incident_id,text})
  -> SEM_CLASSIFY("Assign chain_category to deferred_item_recurred, released_item_failed, incomplete_repair_or_signoff, or maintenance_limitation_escalated.", target_labels=[deferred_item_recurred,released_item_failed,incomplete_repair_or_signoff,maintenance_limitation_escalated], input_bindings={earlier_decision,affected_item,later_discrepancy,operational_effect,text})
)
maintenance_flags := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, aircraft_attributes.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER((attribute = 'maintenance_status_maintenance_deferred' OR attribute = 'maintenance_status_released_for_service') AND value = 'Y')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {maintenance_flags:COLLECT(attribute)})
  -> PROJECT([incident_id,maintenance_status=CASE WHEN maintenance_flags CONTAINS 'maintenance_status_maintenance_deferred' AND maintenance_flags CONTAINS 'maintenance_status_released_for_service' THEN 'both' WHEN maintenance_flags CONTAINS 'maintenance_status_maintenance_deferred' THEN 'deferred' ELSE 'released_to_service' END])
)
chains_with_status := JOIN(left=semantic_chains, right=maintenance_flags, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_chains.incident_id = maintenance_flags.incident_id)
component_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, components.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute IN ('aircraft_component','problem'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {structured_components:COLLECT_IF(value,attribute='aircraft_component'), structured_problems:COLLECT_IF(value,attribute='problem')})
)
joined := JOIN(left=chains_with_status, right=component_records, join_type=inner, condition=chains_with_status.incident_id = component_records.incident_id)
joined
-> GROUP_BY([maintenance_status,discovery_phase,chain_category], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id), chain_records:COLLECT(affected_item,later_discrepancy,structured_components,structured_problems)})
-> SEM_AGGREGATE("For each group, provide one canonical affected item and recurring discrepancy, each in at most six words.", {canonical_affected_item:string, recurring_discrepancy:string}, group_by=[maintenance_status,discovery_phase,chain_category], input_bindings={chain_records})
-> ORDER_BY([incident_count DESC, maintenance_status ASC, discovery_phase ASC, chain_category ASC])
-> LIMIT(12)
-> PROJECT([rank=ROW_NUMBER(),maintenance_status,discovery_phase,chain_category,incident_count,canonical_affected_item,recurring_discrepancy])
